context: Daichi tries cooking; uses a new gadget at home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: メイ、今夜、和食、作ってみる!
lines.en: Mei — I'm gonna try making Japanese food tonight!
lines.style: Bright, animated energy from the start. Warm Kansai lilt on the opening. Generous and eager — the tone of someone excited to show up for someone he loves. Fast-paced, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: まあ、頑張ってね、応援する!
lines.en: Oh, go for it — I'm cheering you on!
lines.style: Soft, genuinely encouraging. No performance in it. Warm smile underneath. Steady pace. The kind of support that doesn't need to be loud to land.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: スプーンで、味、見ながら、進めるわ。
lines.en: I'll keep tasting as I go, adjust things along the way.
lines.style: Confident but not boastful. Kansai warmth, slightly lower energy than the opening. Focused — he's thinking through the steps. Gentle conviction in the plan.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 美味いおかず、できるかな?
lines.style: Soft, almost vulnerable underneath the question. Not asking for reassurance exactly — asking if he can do this. Hope mixed with genuine curiosity. Slow, measured.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 工夫しながら、直ぐに、味、整える!
lines.en: I'll work it out, get the flavor right!
lines.style: Quick return to energy and determination. Kansai brightness. Reassuring without being cocky. The voice of someone rolling up his sleeves. Steady, capable rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Heh — I'm looking forward to it.
lines.style: Quiet, warm laugh at the start. Tender without being shy. Genuine affection in the simplicity. Soft trailing-off at the end, like she's already tasting it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'm doing this for you, you know.
lines.style: Direct, sincere declaration of care. Warm Kansai tone. Not rushed, not hesitant — just honest. The kind of thing he means completely. Slight dip in energy, all feeling.
